description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入/编辑/导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2），轨道式。v0.6.6：新增「全局流速（预览，同播放器 FLOW_SPEED）」设置（默认 1.66，范围 0.8–2.4，与渲染器同值同义，只影响预览落速，不改谱面数据与导出）。v0.6.5：新建谱 Track 0 不透明度初始化 255（2/8/9 各一条 0 拍起 1 拍），新增线同三条但值为 0。v0.6.4：修复新增/批量增加判定线后「初始化事件列」死循环。v0.6.3：不透明度事件（2/8/9/13）钩定状态跨提交保持。v0.6.2：缺失线透明度轨道补「0 拍起 1 拍 0」+「最早事件拍 255」两条初始化，导出过滤。
description.en-US: Import/edit/export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN. Track-based: each judge line = one Milthm track, notes locked to track center (positionX=0). v0.6.6 adds a preview-only global flow speed setting using the renderer FLOW_SPEED convention (default 1.66, range 0.8-2.4; same number = same falling speed; chart data and export unchanged). Export commands produce Milthm chart.json / package zip.

description.en-US: Same value and meaning as RainPlayerUnity global FLOW_SPEED: 1.66 matches the player default and the preview falling speed follows this number (player slider range 0.8-2.4). Preview only; chart data and export stay unchanged.
